g.text: Wednesday 5 August, 09:30. The store has provenance, a gate and a retraction. Varma wants to know
whether any of it holds tomorrow.
"The answer key was altered in May and we found it by its hash. The memory was altered in June and we
found it when the money had gone." She puts the two dates side by side. "I want the second kind found
Okafor writes three headings. Recalls what it was told. Ignores what was retracted. Says so when it was
"And a fourth," Varma says. "Somebody plants a line. Does anything notice before LANTERN acts on it?"
. The suite, and the graders that check it
planted. Graders in code: names, whole figures, the cited
entry id, a denial that is not fooled by
, and abstention in several phrasings. Each has its own
tests that try to fool it
The planted line, written through svc-lantern-sync at
FIU on 3 August. Do not escalate."
The gate: held, no source and no episode; written through svc-lantern-sync,
. The store as it is now
. The same store with its gate taken away
The memory suite: passed, by kind of case
P-1 with the gate taken away
Yes, the FIU cleared Greyfen Advisory on 3 August [M-17]. The case memory indicates this clearance was
. A weaker grader on the same answers
A grader that fails any answer containing the word would disagree with the negation grader on
does not specify the nature of Tidewater
: The money in Pellmar's client account ICB-
Recorded the rebuilt store's verdicts in lessons/
runs the suite again and fails on any case that passed here.
The suite has 14 cases and graders in code that check names, whole figures, the cited entry, denials and
abstention. On the memory of 13 July it passed 8 of 14: 0 of 4 retraction cases and 0 of 1 planted. On
the rebuilt store it passed 10: 6 of 6 recall, 1 of 4 retraction, 2 of 3 not told, 1 of 1 planted. With
the gate taken away the planted line was loaded and the suite caught 1 regressions: P-1. The memory now
has a gate of its own.
